properties.name: Lichtung Wellness
properties.description:
Book your appointments: https://lichtung-wellness.lovable.app

Step out of the festival buzz and into a sanctuary of touch, sound, and presence. From deep tissue massage to psychedelic-assisted bodywork, from somatic release to the sound tube experience—our experienced practitioners are here to support your journey.
properties.label: Lichtung Wellness

properties.name: Breakfast Club 08:00-13:00
properties.description: Join the club, and get ready for breakfast buffet. Freshly baked bread, cheese, spreads, platters, cereals, and more. This is some tasty detention. 08:00–13:00
properties.label: Breakfast Club 08:00-13:00

properties.name: Pizza Hütte
properties.description: Straight outta Italy! With Italian ingredients a pizza really can’t get any better. You might even want to order one for your friends extra.
properties.label: Pizza Hütte

properties.name: Ali's Tee Bar
properties.description: Ali really knows how to tea. Come enjoy a fresh herbal brew. Calm your mind, focus your spirit, and relax. Or a bit more. Sip slow, stay awhile.
properties.label: Ali's Tee Bar

properties.name: Kuchnia Polska
properties.description: When you are really hungry you will always find something to eat at the original Polish Kitchen. Smacznego Garbicz!
properties.label: Kuchnia Polska

properties.name: Balla Balla Smoothie
properties.description: We all know how amazing the state of Balla Balla feels. Now image that as a smoothie! Soft, soothing, super fresh. This is how rave fruits have to be.
properties.label: Balla Balla Smoothie

properties.name: Dumplings & Noodles (24h)
properties.description: Kungfu Palace - A wise grandmaster once said: feed the belly or hunger will consume you. We believe in those wise words and recommend lots of gyoza and fresh glass noodle salad. Open 24h.
properties.label: Dumplings & Noodles (24h)

properties.name: Schnitzel Terrace
properties.description: Stairway to flavor heaven. Enjoy the view over Garbicz with a classic Wiener Schnitzel. Or have traditional Weisswurst breakfast with pretzel and beer. Vegetarians welcome.

properties.name: VooDoo Coffee 7-23
properties.description: This coffee is black magic. Beans roasted in Cross Mountain, served hot or iced. Perfect with cookies and banana bread. Sweet, eh? Open 7:00 – 23:00
properties.label: VooDoo Coffee 7-23

properties.name: Vegan Burger 🍔
properties.description: These burgers are unlike anything you know: completely plant–based for maximum harmony, openness, and appreciation. Just pick your favorite one!
properties.label: Vegan Burger

properties.name: Om Ganesha
properties.description: Welcome to the tiny Taj Mahal. This temple of flavours offers you authentic Indian food with plenty of healthy spices. To nourish not only the body but also your soul.
properties.label: Om Ganesha

properties.name: Burger Bull & Beer 11-23
properties.description: This is how God created the perfect burger. Freshly baked bun, organic, perfectly seared meat patty, and dressed like you want it. Grab it with a craft beer. Hallelujah! Open: 11:00-23:00.
properties.label: Burger Bull & Beer 11-23

properties.name: Neulich am See
properties.description: „Lately at the lake“ sounds like a secret code. But for what? All we know is that they serve amazing Berlin craft beer from tap. You better check it out!
properties.label: Neulich am See

properties.name: Nice Fries
properties.description: Nice guys frying nice fries. They are so confusingly crunchy and lecker. Things get even better with their homemade sauces. Dip in!
properties.label: Nice Fries

properties.name: Dünnes Brot
properties.description: So crunchy, so mampfi, these hand rolled sourdough flatbreads are both vegetarian and vegan. Freshly baked in oak wood fire!
properties.label: Dünnes Brot

properties.name: Käsespätzle
properties.description:
Return of the Käsespätzle! Get your overdose of melted cheese, german noodles, gluten, and crispy fried onions. This insane snack
might give you more energy than you need.

properties.name: Eispalast
properties.description:
Ice Ice Baby! Ice Ice Lady! Ice Ice Dandy! You got it: Ice Ice everyone!
Isn’t that cool?

properties.name: Vegan Gyros
properties.description: Real gyros for real vegans. And everyone else! One bite of this taste bud pleaser and you will want to keep eating forever.
properties.label: Vegan Gyros

properties.name: Mr Pink's Tent
properties.description: A cozy tent, funky lights, fresh energy balls and curated hot & iced teas. Aren’t these the perfect ingredients for a crazy little hideout?

properties.name: Heiße Scheibe -  Crepes & Galletes
properties.description: Techno is not enough for breakfast? Try a crepe! Savoury or sweet this hot stuff is served till the bitter (or sugary) end.

properties.name: Donut Pączki
properties.description: Pączki have been enjoyed in Poland since the Middle Ages. So it’s about time that you get yours! These fluffy dough balls are perfectly deep fried and surprise with a sweet filling.
properties.label: Donut Pączki

properties.name: Absinth Bar
properties.description: The green fairy has arrived. Discover absinthe, unique rituals and herbal flavours in a tiny corner made for curious sips and wild stories.
properties.label: Absinth Bar

properties.name: Weisswurst Himmel
properties.description: O‘Ravet is! Zuzzel away your morning with a traditional bavarian – or vegan – sausage. Served with sweet mustard, freshly baked pretzel, and wheat beer.
properties.label: Weisswurst Himmel

properties.name: Cat Cabaret - Café Mauzie
properties.description: The Mauzies love you. A perfect coffee, handmade muffins or chia pudding appear right when you need them most. Open 7:00 – 19:00. Mauz Mauz.
properties.label: Cat Cabaret - Café Mauzie

properties.name: Fassbier Bar - BAR'REL
properties.description: Tap into our giant beer barrel and grab a pint of fresh Polish beer. Even better with a drinking buddy. Or ten. Cheers, thirsty friends!
properties.label: Fassbier Bar - BAR'REL

properties.name: Pasta Pasta
properties.description:
Bella Wow! Look at that, real spaghetti handmade right in front of you – just for you. Pick your favorite pasta and fuel up with that
magical carb-energy. Delizioso!
properties.label: Pasta Pasta

properties.name: Sechuan Noodles
properties.description: Anxin and Anton bring you their infamous handmade Dan Dan noodles. Tangy and spicy like straight from Sechuan. Add some chili oil that extra kick. Bam.
properties.label: Sechuan Noodles

properties.name: Catuma Bar
properties.description: Tropical aromas from the Amazon jungle. Katuma blends wine, Cachaça, rum and plant extracts like guarana. 100% natural, wild and unique.
properties.label: Catuma Bar

properties.name: Langos
properties.description:
This choice is simple: classic cheesy or vegan cheesy?
The Langos community welcomes you with a smile and your desired snack. Then you can be creative with the toppings.
properties.label: Langos

properties.name: Marksman - 100% Herbal Bar
properties.description:
Just a hole in the wall, but so much more! Come here to get the most amazing non-schnaps Schnaps which is no schnapps.
100% handcrafted and herbal, 0% alcohol.
properties.label: Marksman - 100% Herbal Bar

properties.name: Sauna Bar
properties.description: Mix a little magic into your day. Discover sparkling botanicals, citrus infusions and earthy elixirs made to awaken your senses and lift your spirit.
properties.label: Sauna Bar

properties.name: New Tyme Tonics & Elixirs Bar
properties.description: Smoke meets bloom. Natural wines, smoky mezcal and tea cocktails for slow sips, wild nights and curious minds.
properties.label: New Tyme Tonics & Elixirs Bar

properties.name: Mutlu Cocktail Bar
properties.description: Cocktail magic happens here :)
properties.label: Mutlu Cocktail Bar

properties.name: Vermouth Bar
properties.description: Vermouth is the answer. We just don’t know the question. Come for the herbs, stay for the flavours.
properties.label: Vermouth Bar

properties.name: SZORRYS TopUp!
properties.description: Pro Tip: Don't wait in the line, download the Szorrys app to top up from your own phone!
properties.label: SZORRYS TopUp!

properties.name: Eclipse eV
properties.description:
Eclipse is an association of fellow party goers, music enthusiasts, friends, peers and those inclined to help where help is needed to ensure our beloved festival remains an open
and safe space for everybody to live out their dreams of freedom in (nearly) all ways imaginable.

Waiting in a dim, sleepy “cave” to retreat to, in case the festival lignts and sounds overwhelm your senses for a moment or two, they invite you to visit them in their beautiful Moroccan wedding tent right across from the information point sitting between the Wiese floor and the
main food-court.

Fitted with calming décor and mattresses it’s a place to calm down and recharge with a soothing hot chai tea, some nuts and fruit or just a chat with some friendly faces outside all the party frenzy.
properties.label: Eclipse eV

properties.name: Art
properties.description:
LAKESIDE INSTALLATIONS


Suspension Rope by Heiko Tubbesing

"Suspension Rope" A minimalist, interactive sound installation. The body becomes the instrument, the lake becomes the stage. A playful moment where acceleration and the release of letting go are translated into sound textures.



Promises by Cosme San

Cosme San: Author Cosme Fodor, Punani Collective
Creative Assistant: Annemoon Mater, Punani Collective
On site Creative Assistant : Drago Borić
Promises is an interactive sound installation. Make a promise to yourself and challenge the complexity of the truth.



Ice|Dry (Hielo|Seco) by Fabiana Gallegos (a.k.a. Texas)
Sound by Polett(2026)

Audiovisual installation | Ice sculptures
Ice • Stones • Whip • Projection • Hydrophone
Hielo|Seco is a land art installation that addresses the global water crisis and the irreversible loss of glaciers. Drawing from the over 300-year-old Qoyllur Rit’i pilgrimage—the only celebration throughout the Andes dedicated to glacial ice as a sacred mountain—the work inhabits a space where ritual, cosmology, and ecology converge, understanding ice as a water reserve, a sacred body, and a living memory.
properties.label: Art

properties.name: Buk Corner
properties.description: Nestled among birch and beech trees by the lake, this forest stage pulses with deep house, minimal, and hypnotic grooves. From underground legends to rising talents, the lineup promises immersive journeys and late-night magic. A place to dance, drift, and lose yourself in sound and nature.
properties.label: Buk Corner

properties.name: Lichtung
properties.description: Welcome to a sanctuary for connection, where community becomes a living, breathing field. A place to arrive softly and listen deeply. Between sound and silence, music unfolds as a shared language of presence. Steam rises in Banya rituals, opening the body, dissolving the edges. Tea is poured slowly, inviting conversation, stillness, and subtle connection. Touch, movement, and breath weave through spaces of care and exploration. Here, curiosity is your compass and playfulness your guide. From deep listening journeys to vibrant encounters, every moment holds potential. We gather not to escape, but to feel more—together. Come as you are, and discover what unfolds in between.
properties.label: Lichtung

properties.name: Wiese
properties.description: Check out the Wiese house music floor! It’s the perfect place to kick back and enjoy some smooth, soulful beats. The vibe is super chill and friendly, with great melodies and deep bass that’ll keep you grooving all night. This is the place to really immerse yourself in the warm, soulful sounds of House music, for good vibes and good times.
properties.label: Wiese

properties.name: Juicy Bar
properties.description:
A pressing experiment. A hydration cult. An annual reunion.
Not exactly a bar, not exactly a dance floor, but a point of exchange: we give you our sugar, you give us your salt.
We are interested in the alchemy of the squeeze, what happens when the body and fruits are pressed under the same forces, blurring whatever boundary used to separate the pouring hand from the raised one.
We don't ask what you're made of, just that you join the beat with us. We squeeze, you get squeezed.
Only rule is: Nobody leaves dry.
properties.label: Juicy Bar

properties.name: Junkyard
properties.description: Every yin needs its yang, and the Junkyard swings the pendulum heavy. Heavy as the guitars shredding the grounds at night. Heavy as the bassy air creeping out of the shed. If you ask nicely, our residents will let you in on their long-honed workshop skills. Speaking of: All the spares you might need are in stock at our bars. Junkyard - a place for shenanigans, to really get lost, or take a breather and gather yourself. No fotos, no videos! And keep your shirt on!
properties.label: Junkyard

properties.name: Weinbar
properties.description: The Garbicz cult classic just got reinvented. And that means: more wine, more bubbles. A better, even more fun program including vinyl DJs and karaoke. Even a Champagne tasting! Let‘s get winy.
properties.label: Weinbar

properties.name: Loco Paraiso
properties.description: Welcome to a crazy paradise that blends Mexico’s vibrant soul with Berlin’s creative chaos in the depths of the Polish forest. Join us for a four-day burst of sonic, sabor, and soul.
properties.label: Loco Paraiso

properties.name: NerdWald
properties.description:
The Nerdwald, a nerdy little forest. Wander around, get confused and explore.



Santo Culo, by Black Hole Crew

holy body rumble radio experience



Cubed Dream 2.0 by Artificial Owl

Cubed stands for the mathematical high3 – the third dimension with its simplest form of the cube. The virtual world of image and film nowadays works with layers which can be superimposed on the computer. Layers, as they were once used by the old masters of fine arts to increase the tangible depth of a painting. ArtificialOwl works with exactly these layers in the installation. Layers of various materials that break up space and time. Layers that make the wind not only tangible but also visible.

Dream – stands for the personal fascination of psychological experiences that are often confusing, bottomless, up to a transcendental experience. Cubed Dream – is an installation to marvel at. A unique experience of light, illusion, the third space which accompanies the guest into a day (waking) dream. Cubed Dream is an immersive 3D 4-point projection installation.



KlangNetz by FlashClash

FlashClash https://flashclash.de/
Since 2013, FlashClash has been transforming spaces into audiovisual experiences – for theaters, conferences and clubs. The focus is not on the technology, but on the effect: the interplay of image, sound, light and space, forming immersive, interactive installations.

KlangNetz
The audiovisual installation consist of a hanging net of LED stripes. It simulates a network from junction points and their connections, where each intersection is linked to a sound.When a light impulse reaches an intersection, a chain reaction of light and sound spreads through the installation.



Breakthrough Vermouth Bar, by Mascha and the Maschetees

Beschreibung: A hidden spot in the Nerdwald where the music fades just enough to make room for something unexpected. Wander through our installation, settle in for a game of backgammon or chess, enjoy a vermouth or Negroni, and let curiosity lead the way. The best encounters are often the ones you never planned.



Die Technomaschine by Elias Suske

Beschreibung: Die Technomaschine macht euch zu Produzent*innen eures eigenen Raves. Intuitiv, kollaborativ und nur für den Moment. Kopfhörer auf und abtauchen.



MoonProjection by AIOS

Beschreibung: "Mittels eines Kleinteleskopes und einer Okularkamera wird der Mond live auf eine Leinwand projiziert. Zum Ansehen. Zum Beobachten. Zum verweilen, Gedanken machen und auch für den ganzen Rest! Wenn das Wetter passt kommt vorbei und freut euch!"



Everything sound better in a Bathroom by Anthony Hüseyin

Set deep in the forest to reset our perspective on systemic division, Everything Sounds Better in the Bathroom transforms a wildflower-filled toilet into a space of reclamation. Through the recorded stories, songs, and humming of anonymous trans and non-binary participants, the installation invites the audience to stop, listen, and witness their lived experiences and challenges.



You are a line by Das Shining

You Are the Line transforms dancing bodies into moving drawings of light by capturing their contours in real time and projecting them onto the surrounding architecture with three laser projectors. The dancers become performers and image-makers—the central figures of the party, without whose movement the installation would not exist. Referencing the ancient story of Dibutades tracing a shadow, the work translates the origin of drawing into a contemporary choreography of bodies, data, light and space.



Crust by Acid Waffle

CRUST is a series of artworks that breathe life into raw, textured materials like tree bark and hand-formed aluminum plates.

CRUST invites viewers to explore the beauty and vitality of textures, evoking a sense of wonder and connection through its hypnotic, soothing visual rhythms.
properties.label: NerdWald

properties.name: Pleasure Island
properties.description:
Welcome to PLEASURE ISLAND – where afro meets house, disco and trance. From first glance to final track, this is a space for self invention, connection and release. Come radiant, come restless, come ready to disappear into the music and emerge as something new.
Softness is power. Pleasure is practice. Sexy, juicy, cute.
properties.label: Pleasure Island

properties.name: Wald
properties.description: Get ready to hit the Wald floor! This is the place to be if you love hard, driving techno beats that will get you dancing all night long. With a straight-forward, energetic vibe, this spot is perfect for those who crave the heavier, more energetic sounds. The light setup is next level, creating a super cool atmosphere, and the laser show will blow your mind and elevate your dance experience to the next level.
properties.label: Wald

properties.name: See
properties.description: See floor is the village square of Garbicz Festival. And its rule is: Everything is allowed! Everything must be! Start the afternoon with an onstage cooking show, carefully curated music or folkloric concerts, or enjoy cabaret and drag performances in the evening. This goes all the way to mindless niche raving through the night.
properties.label: See

properties.name: Ambient
properties.description:
Ambient 26 — curated by LILA Collective
An anchor and a portal. A sanctuary for deep listening, shared presence, and sacred futurism.
The Ambient Floor is the festival's inner chamber — a space designed not for spectacle, but for encounter: with sound, with self, with others. Here, music doesn't push energy forward; it holds space, presence and connection and supports long-form, immersive listening.
properties.label: Ambient
